Tenacious Origin of Life.sourceNote: Use an Alchemy Tool at Skilled 1 or higher with the normal, high-quality, or special herb formula to produce 1-3.

Rough Opulent Crystal.sourceNote: Use an Alchemy Tool at Skilled 1 or higher with 50 each of Translucent, Mud, Black, Blue, and Violet Crystal to produce 1-3.

Flawless Spirit Stone.sourceNote: Use an Alchemy Tool at Skilled 1 or higher with 10 Oil of Tranquility, 4 Tenacious Origin of Life, and 4 Rough Opulent Crystal to produce 1-3.

Elixir of Sharp Detection.sourceNote: Use an Alchemy Tool with 1 Oil of Storms, 6 Pure Powder Reagent, 3 White Truffle Mushroom, 3 Trace of Nature, and 2 Old Tree Bark to produce 25-35. A generic Truffle Mushroom cannot replace White Truffle Mushroom here.
